main_text.p: piorum veritas vnam facit, adiectionum error & impietas, insociabilem. Neque tam nobiscum pugnat posthuma hęc & spuriitraditionum soboles, quàm cum illis ipsis quæ stabilire maximè discupiunt authores, religionis suæ principijs: A facie ergo, Romana Ecclesia & nostra est, & Dei est ; à tergo aliena est, Antichristiana est: Planius ; μὴ γὰρ Παλεκτίον τῆς μεταφορᾶς, verè Clemens : Fundamentum & tenet Roma, & tollit ; Directè tenet, tollit ex consequente ; quà tenet, vera Ecclesia est, quantum -libet impurata ; quà tollit, ἐκκλησία πεπιστευμένων est, quicquid simuletPsal.26.5. pietatis

page.notes: Greek words in the text are printed in a faded, partly damaged state; the Greek readings are approximate. The marginal note "Psal.26.5." is at the right beside the last line. The catchword "pietatis" is read from the foot of the column.
